description: Search the NATIONAL BUSINESS REGISTERS by company name and get the register's own id back, a Companies House number, a Norwegian organisasjonsnummer, a Finnish business id, a SIREN, a Japanese corporate number, an Estonian registry code, a CRO number, a CNPJ, a US state entity number, or an LEI. Use this when you want the OFFICIAL REGISTERED ENTITY. Registers searched: Companies House (GB), Enhetsregisteret (NO), PRH/YTJ (FI), Sirene (FR), 法人番号公表サイト (JP), RIK e-Business Register (EE), the Compan

country.description: OPTIONAL ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the register you mean ("GB", "NO", "FI", "FR", "JP", "EE", "IE", "US", "BR"). Narrows the fan-out, and is frequently the difference between an answer and `ambiguous` on a short name. The Irish register and the US state registers are asked ONLY when you pass "IE" or "US". The GLEIF crosswalk is asked whatever you pass, because for several jurisdictions it is the only register we can name at all.

limit.description: Maximum candidates to return, 1-50 (default 10). Does not change which registers are asked, only how many rivals come back.

name.description: The company name as you have it, in its own script. Pass it VERBATIM, do not strip the legal form ("Oyj", "AS", "株式会社", "Ltd"): in Japanese the form is a PREFIX as often as a suffix and 株式会社花王 and 花王株式会社 are DIFFERENT companies, so the form is often the only evidence that separates two candidates. Diacritics, full-width characters and kana are all handled.

state.description: OPTIONAL two-letter US state ("FL", "NY", "CO"...), with country "US" (implied when country is absent). It means the state where the company is registered or was formed, not where it is headquartered: a Delaware company headquartered in California is "DE", and passing its headquarters state asks a different question (omit `state` if you only know the headquarters). A state we hold a register for narrows the search to that register alone. A state we do not (Delaware, California) is answered from GLEIF and SEC EDGAR, with the coverage stated in `state_coverage`, and every covered register is also searched for foreign registrations of a company formed there. Omit to search every covered state register.

name: nps__company_register_search
